title: Best Lightweight Laptops (2026)
summary: 5 tested laptops from 1.5 to 3.4 lb that are easy to carry all day.
method: Picks come from PCWorld's hands-on laptop testing (updated Oct 2026). Specs and battery figures are for the configuration they tested; Amazon listings can differ, so check the exact configuration before buying. We don't show prices because they change daily. Weights are the manufacturer figures reported in PCWorld's reviews.
assumptions: portability was the main need; budget and operating system were open.

products.name: Microsoft Surface Pro
cons: Only ~2h at full brightness under heavy use

products.name: Apple MacBook Neo
pros: Feels premium for the price class
cons: The two USB-C ports differ in speed
Touch ID only on the higher-priced model
products.best_for: A light, premium-feeling Mac for less.

products.name: Framework Laptop 13
products.best_for: People who want to repair and upgrade their own laptop.

products.name: Dell 14S
pros: Longest battery life PCWorld has recorded
cons: Performance is only so-so for the money
products.best_for: Light carry plus very long battery life.

products.name: Acer Swift 16 AI (Lunar Lake)
pros: Lasts a full day of classes
